secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI-powered workflow generation. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Without it, the app uses fallback blueprints.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for the Python backend agent engine. Optional - used by the backend LLM provider.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the Python backend agent engine. Optional - used by the backend LLM provider.

secrets.name: N8N_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the local n8n automation engine. Optional - the backend gracefully handles n8n being unavailable.
